notes.title: 🌲Forest Ranger Simulator Fully Released + Major Update!
notes.content:
[h3]Hello Forest Rangers,
The day has finally come! 🏆[/h3] 

[previewyoutube=F0w2qoI7rYM;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3][b]Today is the BIG DAY we've been waiting for! - full release of Forest Ranger Simulator[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36177732/de6e273e873606187023193d0024ab07d6e2add9.jpg[/img]


Thanks for your [b]support, reviews, and information you provided,[/b] We've made it to this very moment! ːsteamhappyː 


[h3][b][u]To celebrate the premiere, we have uploaded a major update![/u][/b][/h3]

List of Full Release Update changes:

[list]
[*] Seasons added! Preparatory Season, Tourist Season
[*] Additional map of forest areas!
[*] Any forest area can be purchased!
[*] Expanding forest areas!
[*] Tourists visiting the forest during the season!
[*] Water demand system!
[*] Replenishing the water you need!
[*] Steam Achievements!
[*] Minor bug fixes!
[/list]


If you still haven't you can get Forest Ranger Simulator with a 40% discount, but in a bundle for even less. 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1185780/Forest_Ranger_Simulator/


Relax and have fun
Forest Ranger Simulator team

P.S. Yesterday we announced a big and important game "[b]Purrrifiers[/b]". If you want to support us (Freemind or dev of the game) or have a chance to get into the beta test please wishlist now

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2117430/Purrrifiers/

notes.title: 🌲Forest Ranger Simulator🌲 Full Release is coming🐻
notes.content:
Hello Forest Ranger Simulator fans🐻🌲

[h2]We have a big announcement today❗️[/h2]

[h3][b]📣Forest Ranger Simulator is getting out of Early Access on June 19[/b]! We have prepared a [u]discount[/u]💲 and a [u]major update[/u]🌲 on the release![/h3] [u]Achievements are coming![/u]

From the first day of the Early Access of the game, we've provided a variety of updates. We have always listened to you - our community and give you as much fun as possible in Forest Ranger Simulator. 

[previewyoutube=EeFhIyNSKDU;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]With the full release, there will be a [b]MAJOR UPDATE[/b] uploaded. In the upcoming days, we will share more info about it.[/h3]



if you still haven't played [b]Forest Ranger Simulator[/b], now could be the right time.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1185780/Forest_Ranger_Simulator/

We want to thank everyone who supported the project. Those who didn't like it, maybe now when full release is coming you can give it a second chance.


Have fun.
Forest Ranger Simulator team
